headline: Tesla robotaxis go driverless in Miami
body: A quiet day. Tesla expanded unsupervised robotaxi service to Miami, its fifth city, a small step up in AI Autonomy that nudges Conquerors and Zookeeper. Robotaxis without safety monitors are a concrete example of AI acting without a human in the loop. Otherwise lines drifted as older stories faded. Horizon Balance: +2.04.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Enslaved God -0.07, from fading earlier news (-0.06) and Tesla's unmonitored robotaxis (-0.01); Protector God -0.03, from fading earlier news (-0.05), partly offset by Tesla's unmonitored robotaxis (+0.02).
